questions.question: What does Proverbs 19 say is better than riches?
options: A poor person who walks in his integrity
A position of great power and rule
A famous name known to all
A long life filled with many years
questions.answer: A poor person who walks in his integrity

questions.question: What does Proverbs 19 say a man's folly does?
options: Wins for him a great host of loyal and ever faithful friends
Makes him the envy of all of his far wiser neighbors round about
Quietly prospers him in every single thing he sets out to do
Brings his way to ruin, yet his heart rages against the LORD
questions.answer: Brings his way to ruin, yet his heart rages against the LORD

questions.question: Proverbs 19 says whoever is generous to the poor lends to the LORD.
